fields.label: Connection
fields.help: How the hub reads the inverter. A Pocket WiFi 3.0 on firmware 3.004.03 or later answers Modbus TCP, with no password - the SolaX app shows its version. The web API is for a Pocket WiFi 2.0, a Pocket LAN or older firmware.

choices.label: Modbus TCP (Pocket WiFi 3.0, LAN port, RS485 adapter)
Dongle web API (Pocket WiFi 2.0, Pocket LAN)

fields.label: Address
fields.help: The IP address of the dongle - or of the inverter's LAN port, or the adapter - as your router lists it. Just the address: no http://, no port.
fields.patternMessage: Just the IP address or host name - no http://, no port, no path.

fields.label: Modbus port
fields.help: 502, unless an adapter was set to another.

fields.label: Modbus unit ID
fields.help: 1 for a Pocket WiFi 3.0. On the inverter's own LAN port or an adapter, the Modbus address set in the inverter's menu - 1 unless it was changed; some come set to 4.

fields.label: Modbus framing
fields.help: Leave on Modbus TCP. RTU over TCP is only for an RS485 adapter in transparent mode.

fields.label: Web page username
fields.help: Only if the dongle's own web page asks for a username too - usually admin. Leave empty otherwise.

fields.label: Web page password
fields.help: The dongle's registration number, unless it was changed: the code starting with S on its label, which is also the name of its Wi-Fi hotspot. An X-Hybrid needs none.

fields.label: Register table
fields.help: Leave on Automatic. Type 4 is read with the X1-Boost table; pick the X1-Mini one if the temperature, feed-in and grid import read wrong.
